posts.title: withTaskCancellationShield: Swift 6.4 new feature
posts.description: I loved Swift 6.4's new withTaskCancellationShield, until I saw it only works on the 27 OSes. So I dug into why, and built a way to use it on earlier versions.

posts.title: Communication between main app and extension using Darwin Notification
posts.description: How do you tell a DNS proxy extension that its 250k-domain blocklist changed? Not with `NotificationCenter` — that stops at the process boundary. Darwin notifications, `notifyd`, C callbacks, and why "system-wide" cuts both ways.

posts.title: Actors in Swift: The Problem They Solve and How it Works
posts.description: I finally read SE-0306 and actors stopped being a mystery. Here's everything that clicked, in plain language.
